regions.merged_text: But if the primary object of my creation and my existence as a rational creature is to know my Creator, and this, in order that I may be able to love Him and serve Him, and finally by cooperating with His grace, blend my existenc with His in eternal, unspeakable glory; then my first obligation, my first charity is to fulfil my obligation of gratitude to my Creator by trying as best I may to recognize My Creator/that thus, I may intelligently appreciate and some way manifest appreciation. In other words, reason itself and gratitude for my creation - gratitude for the "next to infinite manifestations of God my Creator's/wisdom and power and goodness and love"/demands that I really ought make the science of my relationship with Him, my Creator and God - the primary and the out- standing business of all my faculties, in all places and at all stages of my rational existence. Perhaps someone will wonder if there is such a science. Well, if there be no such science, then I would say there can be no rational creatures either. Because the very first and surest indications of intelligence, as I figure, is gratitude for favors received. And since the very first favor any creature can receive is its creation and creature can(not) come into existence of itself
